metadata.title: Marvell, Lumentum Stocks Headed for Historically Bad Weeks<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why the Marvell and Lumentum Megadeal Has Both Stocks Headed for Historically Bad Weeks
Marvell Technology on Monday said it plans to acquire Lumentum Holdings at a valuation of $115 billion. By Friday, shares of each company were on pace for historically poor weekly performances.
